# GSAP 3.13.0

本目录包含 npm 官方 `gsap@3.13.0` 包内未经修改的浏览器脚本
`dist/gsap.min.js` 和 `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js`。两份脚本在本地加载，以支持离线使用。

These files retain their original notices and are provided under the
[GSAP Standard License](https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/).
The repository's license applies to the project's own code.

Source: [official npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.13.0).
